dct_description_sm: The Roseville/Miminegash Watersheds Inc. Community-Based Water Monitoring Project aims to continue western Prince Edward Island collaboration efforts in water data collection for the West Prince area and to determine how much of a differing impact there is on watersheds due to climate change, based on land use. Data was taken with dataloggers.
dct_title_s: Roseville/Miminegash Watersheds Inc. Continuous Logger Data
